vertical_datum: Relative to the published profile minimum; absolute diagram altitude is not used.
interpolation: Piecewise monotone cubic Hermite. Interior Fritsch-Carlson harmonic slopes; flat SF seam. No uniform rescaling of the previous DEM.
method: Read relative heights from the published numerical extremum labels and drawn trace, then register individual official corners to retained native centerline geometry using FIA maps. Intermediate heights are graphical estimates, not measurements.
registration_notes: The old20.046mCityHallpeak near2408m is inconsistent with the F1diagram5.3mrange. The real profile has a modest bridge hump betweenT13andT14. Old2016T1–15are retained; currentT16–19correspond to oldT20–23. The new bypass between oldT15/T20is interpolated nearly flat, not copied from removed corners.
supersedes: Coarse GLO-90 road profile remains retained as source evidence, not as the racing deck. No new lidar or survey is claimed.
controls_note: Dense final native profile samples after PCHIP reconstruction; source_controls_m retains sparse diagram registration.
